claim_type: exact rank characterization + general bounds + conjecture
limitations: The general half-dimension lower bound is proved only through dimension eight; dimensions nine and above with all row and column weights at least three remain open. The full three-quarters lower bound is conjectural, while the row-weight-at-most-two case is proved. The size-five counts and orbit classification are computer-certified. Heuristic support at larger sizes is not proof. The older minors_n5.csv pairing had a packaging mismatch; the corrected file is the relevant certificate.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment completed on 2026-09-30 UTC.
record_title: Minimum real rank of diagonal-ones binary matrices with no all-ones 2x2 submatrix: exact minima for n<=5 and a sharp ceil(3n/4) tiling bound
